title: Palindromic Substrings
description:
Given a string `s`, return the **number of palindromic substrings** in it.

Substrings with different start or end positions count separately, even if they contain the same characters.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Expand around each of the 2n - 1 possible centers and count every successful expansion.
A DP table dp[i][j] = (s[i] == s[j] and dp[i+1][j-1]) also works in O(n^2).
